issues.issue: Is the new evidence admissible (re-issued certificates, husband's affidavit, neighbours' affidavits, third-party communications)?
issues.applicant_position: Evidence could not reasonably have been presented earlier and is relevant.
issues.result_text: Husband's affidavit and one other item admitted; neighbour and other evidence not admitted as not explained.

issues.issue: Should an oral hearing be held on the new evidence?
issues.result_text: New evidence raises no serious credibility issue and is not determinative; no oral hearing.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in its credibility finding that the Appellants' departure on their own passports was implausible?
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored the smuggler's role and speculated about exit controls; departure was plausible.
issues.result_text: RPD erred in its implausibility finding regarding the Appellants' departure from China.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err on its other credibility findings (delay in claiming; opposition to abortion) and its treatment of documentary evidence?
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in the three credibility findings and in its treatment of documentary evidence.
issues.result_text: Court finds RPD erred in the three credibility areas and in its treatment of documentary evidence.
